Want to join one of the fastest-growing companies in the Netherlands in Waddinxveen? 
As a Storage warehouse employee, you are responsible for supporting daily warehouse operations. This is a physically active position where you help move and store goods safely and efficiently. You will work according to a step-by-step rotation system. You will start on the EPT and, once you are comfortable and performing well, progress to the OPT, which can lift goods up to approximately 1.80 metres. After successfully gaining experience with the OPT, you will also be trained to operate the reach truck. This system allows you to gradually develop your skills and work with different warehouse machines while ensuring that goods are handled safely and efficiently. Working hours are from 07:00-16:00. 
Regardless of which truck you are driving, you will always earn the same €16.04 
Other important things that belong to this job: 
Your main tasks: 
 Job Requirements 
 - Proven experience and Dutch certification operating a reach truck and/or EPT/OPT - Willingness to perform order picking tasks - Physically fit and able to perform warehouse work - English language skills are mandatory - Willingness to stay in the position for at least 6 months to 1 year - Flexible and available for shift work - Reliable, motivated, and safety-oriented attitude 
 Employment conditions 
 - Employment contract with Charlie Works 
A growing, international company based in Waddinxveen, specializing in machines, tools, and workshop equipment. From a down-to-earth and entrepreneurial work environment, a dedicated team works every day towards further growth and customer satisfaction.

Ready to start a new job?

Looking for an active warehouse job?

Start your next job at GXO Logistics in Tilburg!

Morning: 06:00 - 14:45

Afternoon: 15:15 - 00:00

You may also occasionally help with checking orders or support the expedition department. You work accurately and are willing to think along when something can be done smarter or more efficiently.

- You speak Dutch or English
